# Pre-Industrial Fire Suppression: Thermodynamics and Self-Reliance

## Introduction

Fire is one of the oldest and most devastating natural disasters. In pre-industrial societies, survival relied heavily on local knowledge and physical barriers. While modern fire suppression relies on chemical agents, the principles of self-reliance remain relevant today.
